q: My buyer wants carbon per kg, but we track it per piece. How do we convert?
title: Carbon per kg instead of per piece
short: Divide the per-piece figure by the net weight of one piece, from your drawing or a scale. If you make many sizes, allocate plant emissions by weight of good output in the first place, which gives a per-kg figure directly and a per-piece figure for each size by multiplying back.
audience: Component, casting and packaging suppliers answering buyer requests

ul: Net weight of the finished piece, not the gross weight including runners or offcuts.
Packaging excluded unless the buyer asks for it.

p: Machined or plated parts use energy per piece more than per kg. Say so, and offer both figures with the method.
Use the same allocation every year and the same weights the buyer sees on your invoices or packing lists.

senseible: Senseible reads your fuel, electricity and purchase documents into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its source.
